description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), causes [Imperil Fire 20% (25s)], [Imperil Earth 20% (25s)], [Imperil Wind 20% (25s)], [Imperil Poison 20% (25s)], [Awoken Engineer], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quad Element Mode (Fire, Earth, Wind, Poison)] and [Overheat Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Engineer
description.text: Unlimited Machinist hones, Machinist abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Machinist abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Quad Element Mode (Fire, Earth, Wind, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Earth]/[Attach Wind]/[Attach Poison] after using a Fire/Earth/Wind/Poison ability

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Poison
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Poison damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Poison resistance +20%

description.name: Overheat Mode
description.text: Fire, Earth, Wind or Poison abilities deal 10/20/30% more damage if the target's Fire, Earth, Wind or Poison weakness is 20/30/40%+
